title: Cauldron Timer
description: Adds a timer display above cauldrons as soon as you press "`" (backtick)
body:
# Cauldron Timer V1
**Important Note: This mod was made only for personal use and may contain bugs.**

Made for servers using [BreweryX](https://modrinth.com/plugin/breweryx)/[TheBrewingProject](https://modrinth.com/plugin/thebrewingproject). I am aware that there is an alternative (clock item) for checking time on cauldrons, however I am too lazy to use them, I like to have visual feedback.

The mod is fairly simple, press "\`" (backtick) to summon a display entity with a timer above a cauldron.
This does not work if you aren't looking at the cauldron, or have another keybind set to `.

I **do not** intent to add the ability to change this keybind, please do not request it.

Any issues? DM me on Discord: snelsterendier.
Please abide by the license.
